body:
## Summary
- add an Audio readiness card to Android Settings with waiting, policy-blocked, no-negotiation, and active PCM states
- expose a read-only StreamClient audio snapshot for active PCM format plus accepted/written packet counters
- refresh the card across session, managed-policy, and audio playback state changes

## Validation
- ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ClientExperienceTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ManagedPolicyUiAvailabilityPolicyTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityTransferReadinessContractTest --console=plain
- ./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=dev.telemachus.display.SettingsDialogLayoutInstrumentedTest --console=plain
- ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --console=plain
- ./gradlew :app:lintDebug :app:assembleDebug --console=plain

Notes: did not launch Vibe Screen/MacHost, did not run swift, did not touch TCC/signing/Keychain/System Settings, and did not run adb reverse.
title: feat(android): show audio readiness in settings
